note: Exists so that benefit-table selection is genuinely INDEPENDENT of rate-table selection across the 1 to 6 April boundary (spec §11, test T22). Sourced on 3 September 2026 from the Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance Up-rating Order 2025, in force 7 April 2025. Before that the table existed with null figures and any calculation needing one raised a DataError rather than guessing, which meant a carer backdating into 2025/26 with the Child Benefit deduction ticked hit a dead end.

guardiansAllowance.eligibilityNote: Both parents dead, or one dead and the other untraceable / serving 2+ years / whereabouts unknown. Parental UK residence condition applies.

sgoAllowanceTaxTreatment.note: Treated as a residence-order allowance; exempt from income tax since 6 April 2010.

incomeSupportApplicableAmounts.note: Weekly rates exactly as printed in DWP 'Benefit and pension rates 2026 to 2027' (updated 16 February 2026), which publishes both years side by side. Sourced independently of the rest of this file, which is still PENDING_SOURCE: the means test needs only these figures, so it can run for 2025/26 while Child Benefit and Guardian's Allowance for that year remain unsourced. Anything that does need those still raises a DataError rather than guessing.

sourcedButUnused.note: Published in the same table and recorded so nobody has to re-source them. Not read by the engine.

capitalRules.tariffAsPrinted: £1 for every £250, or part thereof, between the amount of capital disregarded and the capital upper limit.
